bio: Dre50 is a CWI roster artist. His single Pix (released 2026-01-07) credits Black Lansky as Lyricist and Assistant Producer, with ℗ 2025 Cumulative Web Inc, independently confirmed via distributor receipts (UPC, ISRC) and Deezer metadata. Co-lyricist Andre Rowe; composer Elevated and Friends. Molly is its own 2022 single, not part of the Pix single.
